definitions.explanation: A large city together with the surrounding towns whose people commute into it or depend on it, treated as one area. Common in statistics, planning and news.

examples.japanese: {大阪都市圏|おおさかとしけん}。
{都市圏|としけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Rents are high in the metropolitan areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦およそ→およそ：02534_oyoso⟧⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧・⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧・⟦{名古屋|なごや}→名古屋：19405_nagoya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三大都市圏|さんだいとしけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: About half of Japan's population lives in the three great metropolitan areas of Tokyo, Osaka and Nagoya.

notes:
-⟦{圏|けん}→圏：21183_ken⟧ means "sphere, zone": compare ⟦{首都圏|しゅとけん}→首都圏：18485_shutoken⟧, {文化圏|ぶんかけん}, ⟦{圏外|けんがい}→圏外：07689_kengai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三大都市圏|さんだいとしけん}: the three great metropolitan areas (Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya)
- {大都市圏|だいとしけん}: a major metropolitan area
- ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{都市圏|としけん}: the regions and the big-city areas

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{首都圏|しゅとけん}→首都圏：18485_shutoken⟧: the Tokyo metropolitan area specifically
- ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧: a city itself
